On each gameplay, you can see 7 people waiting for the moment to make a sound. At the bottom of your screen, you can see 20 different colorful elements. Hold the item icon and drag it on a random person. This person will acquire a certain outfit and produce a certain sound. 

Tap a singing person to mute it or touch and hold many singers to hear only them.

Unlock COMBO to watch colorful videos and listen to the whole track. There are some hints that will help you guess the right sound combination to unlock it. 


Now we offer you 4 amazing music albums of different styles:

1) Miami Chill is a great album to start and practice creating beats. Plunge into the atmosphere of relaxation and cool vibes.

2) Shangyuan Festival is an absolute feast! Try to make the first full moon of the year sound.

3) Japanese Samurai will take revenge! Mix the beats to know how they performed military service for nobles. 

4) Magic Phonk will allow you to dive into the atmosphere of real hip-hop and trap music.

Play and get awards that will engage you: 
- Grand Beatbox
- Tag Team
- Mouth Drummer 
- Champion Stage 

...have fun! It's simple and enjoyable!
